os_list.name: Hobby Ticker OS
os_list.description: Prebuilt Raspberry Pi OS image for Hobby Ticker - a fork of Colin Waddell's FlightTracker. Flash with Raspberry Pi Imager, configure via web interface, no command line required.

subitems.name: Hobby Ticker OS (32-bit)
subitems.description: For Raspberry Pi 3 (and Pi 4 / Pi Zero 2 W in 32-bit mode) - pre-installed Hobby Ticker with rgbmatrix drivers

subitems.name: Hobby Ticker OS (64-bit)
subitems.description: For Raspberry Pi 4 and 5 - 64-bit image with Hobby Ticker and drivers pre-installed
